completionCriteria: Static graph discovery covers repository files, packages, imports, APIs, schemas, journeys, tests, security boundaries, and ownership.
Task impact traversal is deterministic, depth-bounded, node-bounded, repository-relative, and fails closed when truncated.
Existing path-based verification remains compatible and incorporates graph-derived paths and protected checks.
CLI graph and impact commands emit governed JSON evidence without executing repository code.
Failure-injection tests prove dependency direction, ownership, protected boundaries, path safety, and traversal limits.
The full repository CI, governed visual evidence, baselines, thresholds, V1 skills, and self-audit remain passing.
nonObjectives: Do not replace repository architecture documents, execute discovered code, or claim runtime call coverage.
Do not auto-approve security, ownership, schema, API, or architecture boundary changes.
Do not mutate QuietPilot, governed baselines, quality thresholds, or production environments.
objective: Add a deterministic, bounded architecture-impact graph to the repository-native development control plane.
title: Bounded architecture impact graph
